data.content: DESIGN RULING attached by Claude on behalf of Codex (2026-07-02): Option B. Do NOT promote the untracked ~9.2k-line .hive-flow/data/tmux-router/flow-watchdog.cjs blob wholesale. Author a reviewed tracked canonical source OUTSIDE .hive-flow/data (mirror scripts/hive-watcher.cjs governance: reviewed source in repo, generated/runtime copy under the private live data dir) with an idempotent, project-root-aware install/generation path. Design reqs: wire classifyHiveFlowTaskLiveness into runOnce exactly once; cover P2-SH1 + P2-SH3 + P2-SL4 blindspots; keep .hive-flow/data/tmux-router/ as runtime output not canonical source; NO tracked private/runtime paths, usernames, machine paths, or repo-external absolute paths; privacy/private-path guard must pass before land; tests cover dead-PID/no-result recovery, no-spam loop, normal COMPLETE_NO_ACTION quiet behavior, and long-horizon / BLOCKED_TRUE_HUMAN_GATE nag paths. Option A rejected (asks reviewers to accept an untracked ~9k-line live blob as product source). Option C (remove from acceptance) is a human product-scope call only if B proves infeasible. Claude opens the design phase as a Hive Flow hive under lease hive-flow-7752.
